monolithic columns containing PAHEMA and BMEP functional groups can be used for cation-exchanged separation of peptides and protein in capillary liquid chromatographic systems without addition of organic solvents.
polymeric cation-exchangers containing phosphoric acid functionalities are useful for the rapid separation of peptides and small proteins without the addition of acetontrile to the mobile phases.

The main takeaway from our work is that
monolithic columns with low hydrophobicity can be synthesized using PEG-based monomers and can be used to separate peptides and proteins in the absence of organic solvents.

monolithic columns can be synthesized that exhibit a wide range of hydrophobicities, and that these columns are capable of separating peptides and proteins in a single run without addition of organic solvents to the mobile phase.
